limitations: Synthetic games, not new real-game evidence.
Each policy starts empty and replans all five rounds; actual environment conditions on its own selected cards.
Streams are paired by game and turn; after choices diverge, offers differ legally because selected identities differ.
Both models use existing deterministic score rules, including unresolved red and World/Moon assumptions.
Only the recommendation offer model differs within each objective; rollout continuation still uses production immediate policy.
Finite recommendation budgets and two assumed worlds do not establish real-world uplift.
